decision.title: updateOrder removed upstream (API 2.0.0)
decision.question: API 2.0.0 removed PATCH /orders/{orderId}, which Mutation.lumen_books_updateOrder calls (D-o4qjtl, status and note). The router will now get an error for every call. 2.0.0 adds POST /orders/{orderId}/refund (refundOrder, optional body {reason}, returns Order, 404/409), which covers only refunds, not status or note changes. What should replace updateOrder?

choices.label: Remove lumen_books_updateOrder now and ask the API owner whether status and note changes have a new endpoint
